detail.longDescription: The Linux desktop deserves native, sovereign software that doesn't eat 1GB of RAM or phone home. We just launched the 2TI Sovereign Suite in native Rust: ✉️ 2TI LMailer (<28MB RAM, local Ollama RAG, encrypted SQLite) 🎵 2TI Cresta (<48MB RAM, bit-perfect PipeWire/ALSA, 4,000+ Auto-EQ curves) 🚀 2TI Launcher (Atomic dpkg rollbacks, authenticated updates) 30-day free offline evaluation: https:// 2tinteractive.com/apps/ # Linux # Rust # ZorinOS # Privacy # SelfHosted # Audiophile # PipeWire # OpenSource # Tech
